pages.title: FNAF Foxy with Torn Fur and Sharp Teeth Coloring Page
pages.description: Foxy from Five Nights at Freddy's appears in this printable coloring page with damaged patches, mismatched eyes, pointed ears, a sharp-toothed grin, and oversized paws.
